commits.headline: fix(rac2): decompress game WAD streams as the disc routine does (#653)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
The map screen can hand the decompressor a stream whose header and body
come from two different maps (game logic, also on the original). The
disc routine reads such a stream without checks and carries on, but the
port's strict decoder threw "a literal runs past the end" and crashed
(T-77, Damosel map). Game calls now use a decoder that follows the
routine: it only stops where the original traps or reads off memory.

commits.headline: feat: smaller game installs on every platform (#656)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
* feat: smaller game installs on every platform

- Android keeps one copy of the disc image: the set-up links to the
  launcher's own copy instead of copying it again (no hard links there).
- The extractor writes only what the port reads (SYSTEM.CNF and the
  boot executable) on every system.
- At start the launcher frees what older set-ups hold and nothing reads,
  and on Android turns a second image copy into a link.

commits.headline: Run Vulkan rendering and presentation on the render worker (#657)
commits.author: pezzadev
commits.body:
Move Vulkan rendering and presentation onto the render worker. Declare draw, compute, and transfer work through the render graph, and preserve mod startup timing and native Vulkan queue compatibility.

Use MoltenVK on macOS with an OpenGL fallback and a manually dispatched presentation smoke test.
